snippet.title: The Saint Wife’s Newlywed Trials - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Dirk, the hero who saved the world, was granted the title of crown prince for defeating the Demon Lord. He was accompanied on his journey by Marianne, a priestess from the countryside. However, the future emperor isn’t permitted to marry a commoner, so their fairy-tale ending was never meant to be.
